rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something that is all-encompassing or covers all aspects.

example.english: This report gives an overall analysis of the plan's pros and cons.
example.traditional: 呢份報告全面分析咗個計劃嘅利弊。
example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 cyun4 min6 fan1 sik1 zo2 go3 gei3 waak6 ge3 lei6 bai6

rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for an overall assessment of a situation, group, or result.

example.english: Overall, this movie is pretty good.
example.traditional: 整體嚟講，呢套戲幾好睇。
example.jyutping: zing2 tai2 lai4 gong2 ni1 tou3 hei3 gei2 hou2 tai2

rows.note: Use this for the broad “generally” or “by and large” sense, without stressing that every factor was considered.

example.jyutping: daai6 zi3 soeng6 di1 on1 paai4 dou1 seon6 lei6

rows.note: Use this when giving an all-things-considered conclusion after taking the relevant factors together.

example.english: Overall, taking all the expenses into account, this trip wasn't expensive.
example.traditional: 總括嚟講，計埋所有開支，今次旅行唔算貴。
example.jyutping: zung2 kut3 lai4 gong2 gai3 maai4 so2 jau5 hoi1 zi1 gam1 ci3 leoi5 hang4 m4 syun3 gwai3
